# Original static GIF pixel fixtures

Created by generate.py with Pillow 12.3.0: palette/interlacing, nonblack
transparent palette entries, local palette, offset image/nonzero background,
and a separate two-frame animation rejection case. PNG references are actual
Pillow convert("RGB") outputs, not q4t outputs. No external imagery or GPU.
See identity.json for exact original bytes and reference hashes.
